what: Evergy is a regulated utility serving Kansas and Missouri, including the Kansas City area. It generates and delivers electricity to about 1.7 million customers.
customers: Households, businesses and industry across Kansas and Missouri.
money: regulated electricity in central and western Kansas
regulated electricity in the Kansas City area
moat: A regulated monopoly across its service territory, with rates set by Kansas and Missouri commissions.
risks: Debt of about $13.5 billion against almost no cash
Kansas and Missouri regulators set allowed returns
Coal plant retirements require replacement generation investment
Revenue grew only about 2% last year
opportunities: Large industrial and data centre projects in Kansas have been announced in its territory
Operating margin of 26% with a dividend yield above 3%
Every approved investment raises the base it earns a regulated return on
watch: Industrial and data centre load commitments and rate case outcomes.
